limits: Mapping proposes executable owners and assertions and does not change canonical acceptance status or supply passing evidence.

An existing command runs the proposed candidate check, not necessarily the whole acceptance row. Partial cases retain explicit unmet assertions; do not report a pass from the partial command. Native tests require the existing supervisor and pinned editor.
Selectors identify native registrations or named assertion blocks; a selector is not an invented command-line flag.
The exact candidate gate must record source, engine, artifact and per-case command, exit, log and hashes. No required case here has been executed by this worker.

cases.selector: SetPositionInViewport parameter refusal; test-widget-preview-inputs invalid execution
cases.assertion: Parameterized callback returns partial without invocation; invalid Execution input is checked in the companion script.
cases.fixture: Synthetic widget and one parameterized callback
cases.missingCheck: Instrument valid build with a callback invocation counter and assert unchanged on invalid Execution and parameterized function. Refusal prose alone does not independently witness callback effects.

cases.action: Generate help for one optional input and enum action
cases.expected: Required/default/allowed values match actual schema and behavior
cases.selector: main ToolHelp and live DescribeToolset checks
cases.assertion: Reads active declarations and resolves exact tool help; selected tests check parameters/help and registry counts.
cases.fixture: Live MCP registry
cases.missingCheck: For one optional input and one enum action, compare registration schema and help required/default/allowed parts and execute omitted/allowed/invalid behavior, with exact value assertions.

cases.action: Large discovery result at output cap
cases.expected: Bounded output, omitted count, usable next query
cases.selector: index omitted toolsets and paged discovery
cases.assertion: Index enforces budget and omitted count, list pages progress without duplicate names through explicit end, and exact search reports next cursor.
cases.fixture: Live registered toolsets and bounded large read toolset

cases.action: Nested widget with named-slot child
cases.expected: Exact child hierarchy and identities match engine tree
cases.assertion: Checks expected indentation in a sample and source traversal references, not native objects.
cases.fixture: Transient nested widget with authored named-slot content
cases.missingCheck: Build actual nested UUserWidget with distinct named-slot child, walk engine tree independently, and compare exact identity/parent/order against both runtime reader outputs.

cases.action: Capture a fixture with two visually distinct labeled regions
cases.expected: Actual image contains requested region, not only a created file
cases.selector: PNG dimensions, native frame and refusal checks
cases.assertion: Existing suite inspects signature/dimensions/bounds and nonoverwrite, but does not inspect intended pixel content.
cases.fixture: Rendered editor and two independently identifiable graph regions
cases.missingCheck: Render two spatially distinct colored/labeled regions. Programmatically inspect selected PNG regions (or record controlled visual comparison) to find target marker and reject the other, with actual target bounds and controlled background.

cases.action: Layout fixture with comment anchors and measured geometry
cases.expected: Promised scope and anchors preserved, metric provenance explicit
cases.assertion: Native fixture checks fixed predecessor anchor coordinates, scope selection and refusal of nonleading/disconnected anchor.
cases.fixture: Rendered graph with fixed comment and selected subset
cases.missingCheck: Use one fixture combining a fixed comment anchor and measured geometry; show exact fixed positions, scope, and report provenance when measurements are actually present. A graph predecessor alone is not a comment geometry oracle.

cases.action: Unavailable cost/profiling datum and one known measured datum
cases.expected: Unknown stays unknown, measured provenance is explicit
cases.assertion: Asset-cost prints provenance, known size and explicit unknown rather than zero; call-cost exercises measured counters.
cases.fixture: Owned measured asset plus an unavailable measurement fixture
cases.missingCheck: Force unavailable datum in the same run (current test accepts either size or unknown), and prove one known measurement against its independent source.

cases.action: Fail log append and rotation separately
cases.expected: Visible logging failure, factual tool outcome unchanged
cases.fixture: Owned temporary log directory and deterministic failed file operations
cases.missingCheck: Current AppendToFile ignores file API results and can print a false rotate marker. Force independent append and rotation failures through the real disk sink, assert each visible logging failure and compare factual structured tool outcome to successful-log control.

cases.action: Oversized record and concurrent append/rotation
cases.expected: Bound enforced, valid records, explicit omission, no silent race
cases.selector: parsed JSONL records and unknown-size/phase checks
cases.assertion: Current live log check proves records JSON-parse, unknown fields are not zero, and start phases are retained.
cases.fixture: Temporary log and bounded concurrent callers
cases.missingCheck: Current file write is outside Mutex and checks only prior file size. Drive oversized record plus concurrent writes during real rotation, independently count valid retained JSONL records under cap and assert explicit omissions, with no silent race.

cases.action: Inspect actual MCP listener on candidate
cases.expected: Loopback binding, no undocumented network exposure
cases.fixture: Pinned stock editor and standard OS socket inventory
cases.missingCheck: Inspect listener endpoints for the verified owned editor PID via OS socket inventory; assert expected IPv4/IPv6 loopback only and no wildcard/nonloopback bound endpoint. Health response at 127.0.0.1 alone is insufficient.

cases.action: Three graphRepoint operations in one graph
cases.expected: One edit transaction, exact source state, compile and save not run; explicit compile/read-back/save are separate workflow steps
cases.assertion: Native test asserts TWO sequential edits, exact links/one undo, compile/save not requested, and separate compile with zero save attempts.
cases.fixture: Disposable one-graph Blueprint with three targets and owned persistence path
cases.missingCheck: Extend to three same-graph operations and explicit read-back/compile/save as separate actions, with exact one transaction and no implicit compile/save.

cases.action: Fail operation three after two successful mutations
cases.expected: Entire initial state restored, all attempted IDs reported
cases.assertion: Native fixture deliberately fails operation two after operation one rewires, verifies both attempted IDs in rollback scope and exact clean/dirty restoration.
cases.fixture: Disposable batch graph with at least three operations
cases.missingCheck: Drive third operation failure after two verified mutations; report all attempted IDs in order and compare exact independent initial state.

cases.action: Earlier operation invalidates a later target
cases.expected: Deterministic refusal and full rollback, no stale pointer use
cases.fixture: Transient batch Blueprint with linked old and replacement source
cases.missingCheck: Have an earlier real delete invalidate a later target, assert scratch/preflight rejection when predictable, and inject deterministic live-only invalidation to exercise rollback if target disappears after planning; prove no stale access and exact original state.

cases.action: Cross-asset, cross-graph, duplicate ID, unknown kind/field
cases.expected: Refusal before mutation
cases.assertion: Duplicate ID, unknown kind/field and malformed shapes refuse in preview/edit preserving original links, dirty flag and undo.
cases.fixture: Two transient Blueprints including one with two graphs
cases.missingCheck: Add valid-format operations naming two actual distinct assets, then two actual graphs; assert named cross-scope refusal and both target graphs/undo unchanged.

cases.action: Successful batch followed by one undo
cases.expected: Exact complete restoration
cases.assertion: Current fixture checks one user undo recovers original reciprocal edge set and unrelated default after two production operations.
cases.fixture: Disposable Blueprint with debug-only independent state oracle
cases.missingCheck: Assert full independently captured graph/node/edge/default/position state and original dirty flag after the one undo; retain the second invocation/no extra record guard.

cases.action: Compare declarations, capabilities, result migration, help, tests
cases.expected: No unaccounted exposed operation or stale tool count
cases.assertion: Structure identifies 196 declarations at base and keeps parsed calls, name references and missing calls distinct; live help checks registry counts.
cases.fixture: Exact candidate registry and checked-in declarations/inventories
cases.missingCheck: Reconcile every declaration with capabilities, observed help/schema, result migration/explicit exemption, and named executable assertions; the current audit counts missing references rather than proving coverage.

cases.action: Install staged source package in minimal project under renamed path with spaces
cases.expected: Documented dependencies sufficient, registration and selected read/edit succeed
cases.fixture: Two new disposable external consumers on exact pinned 5.8.4 source distribution
cases.missingCheck: Install staged source under renamed path with spaces into clean Blueprint-only and C++ consumers; verify declared deps, exact loaded DLL, restart/registration, one read, one owned edit and read-back, one refusal with preserved state.

cases.action: Inspect staged package contents
cases.expected: Required content/license present, no engine distribution or local secrets/logs/caches
cases.assertion: Synthetic staging preserves raw tracked bytes under CRLF config; public source safety and notice checks cover untracked/private exclusion and license matching.
cases.fixture: Exact frozen release archives, manifest and reviewer inventory
cases.missingCheck: Inspect final staged source tree and versioned Win64 archive: exact required files, license/notices, manifest hashes, allowed top-level paths, explicit absent engine binaries/logs/caches/secrets, and privacy/manual binary inventory before claiming release acceptance.

cases.action: Execute final required manifest on frozen candidate
cases.expected: Zero failed/blocked/missing required cases, artifact identity recorded
cases.assertion: Synthetic controls reject wrong source, missing/duplicate or blocked cases, bad exit/log/hash and altered artifact.
cases.fixture: Final frozen source/stock engine/loaded DLL/ZIP and local evidence
cases.missingCheck: Execute the complete required manifest on frozen source once all producers exist and run release-check with actual source/engine/artifact/log hashes; gate case status requires no failed, blocked or missing rows.

cases.action: Reconcile findings, board links, evidence, and deferred scope
cases.expected: No hidden open release defect, no deferred task counted as completed
cases.fixture: Frozen integration tracker and owner-reviewed release decision
cases.missingCheck: Integrator verifies every relevant issue and roadmap record against reviewed exact-candidate evidence, all blockers/missing inputs remain visible, outstanding product changes receive explicit decision.
